title: Python bitwise negation does not have a fixed word length
summary: Bitwise operations on Python integers are interpreted as infinite sign extension, ~0x12 is -19.
applies: Python 3; standard library or built-in integers
detail: When simulating an 8-bit result, limiting the output to the lower 8 bits results in 0xed; you cannot see this byte when printing negative numbers directly.
boundary: Select how many bits should come from the original attachment's field definition; a fixed mask only retains information within that width.
relevance: Determines whether intermediate values need to be truncated when translating fixed-width bitwise operations on the machine into Python.
